title: Cloud Push Notification API: Prevent Massive Infrastructure Crashes
body:
Does your server crash every time you send a massive push notification to your users?

When launching an urgent alert or a B2B campaign, millions of concurrent requests strike your database simultaneously, draining your resources and destroying your conversion rate due to critical delays.

The Trap of Third-Party SaaS and Firebase Limitations

Relying on gateways with hidden fees based on subscriber volume drains your commercial margin, while basic scripts on shared hosting block your critical process queues. If your push notification arrives five minutes late, the sale has already expired.

Our Solution: Serverless Cloud Push API

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we design an elastic, independent cloud infrastructure to process millions of concurrent alerts with zero latency.

  1. Decoupled asynchronous architecture: We separate the dispatch engine from your core application using high-availability queues to shield your database from traffic spikes.
  2. Smart failover routing: We implement a multi-provider system that automatically reroutes traffic if Apple Push Notification service (APNs) or Firebase experiences micro-downtimes.
  3. Atomic token management: We optimize your registered device database to clean up orphaned or duplicate tokens automatically within milliseconds.
  4. Real-time delivery webhooks: We integrate persistent events to monitor exact receipt and click statuses, linking analytics directly to your B2B CRM.

The Real Impact on Conversion Rates

  • 100% savings on external licenses: By eliminating intermediaries and monthly fees based on your active subscriber count.
  • 99.99% uptime during massive campaigns: Your core platform keeps running smoothly while high-volume dispatches are processed.
  • Guaranteed immediate deliverability: Reduction of latency times from minutes to milliseconds for critical transactional alerts.
